name: github-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to GitHub's MCP API for repositories, issues, pull requests, and code.
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop to the GitHub Copilot MCP endpoint (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp) over Streamable HTTP. Provides tools for working with repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, and more. Uses mcp-remote as a stdio-to-HTTP proxy; the only requirement is Node.js (npx) on your PATH and a GitHub Personal Access Token.

github_pat.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
github_pat.description: A GitHub PAT with repo, read:user, and other required scopes. Generate one at https://github.com/settings/tokens.
